latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Capability Evolver — a self-evolution engine for AI agents.

- Enables auto-analysis of runtime history to identify errors and inefficiencies.
- Supports autonomous self-repair: detects failures and suggests or applies code/memory updates.
- Offers various run modes: fully automated, human-in-the-loop review, and continuous evolution loop.
- Includes GEP protocol for structured, auditable evolution with reusable assets.
- Highly configurable with environment overrides and local injection; designed to be environment-agnostic and easily extensible.
- Features built-in safety mechanisms like review mode and risk protocols to prevent runaway changes.
